originality.rationale: The originally motivating source explicitly conjectures, rather than proves, the borderline n=k+5 homotopy shape. Its numeric data stop at cutoff fifteen, whereas this is cutoff sixteen. The closest indexed face-vector/Euler result for all k does not imply integral homotopy, symmetry character or quotient ranks. Later powered-cycle literature addresses three-cut, and total-cut literature has inequivalent definition. No covering implication found in actual source/record searches; unindexed work remains possible.

value.rationale: The exact finite classification is motivated by a published all-parameter homotopy conjecture, and it is the first case just beyond the original 3..15 numerical evidence. The contribution exceeds a routine extra Betti entry: a complete 14x650 integral homotopy reduction, explicit primitive three-cycle, 42-element D21 rational character including exceptional order-three and reflection traces, and exact rational quotient Betti ranks 1 and 12. These structural equivariant facts cannot be recovered from the already known face vector or Euler characteristic; no all-parameter theorem is claimed.
